historia: La Zorra y las Estrellas Perdidas
prompt: Watercolor storybook art, soft gouache brushstrokes, teal forest, warm colors. Luma, small red-orange fox, golden eyes, tiny nose, fluffy fur, large curled comet tail. Scene: A red fox looks at a mirror showing an old man with blue eyes and shadow snake. Forest of mirrors reflects different scenes. Fox has confused and mysterious expression.
